title: Clinical huddle
description: Overnight escalations, today's rota, patients needing a second look. Runs off the [Patient Intake SOP](patient-intake-sop.md). 30 minutes, standing, in [Rila](room:Rila).

title: New joiner welcome
description: Badges, laptops and a tour for [Maria Nikolova](user:maria@uniffy.io). Bring questions on the [First Week Checklist](first-week-checklist.md) and [Systems and Access](systems-and-access.md).

title: Sprint planning: MyVitalis portal
description: Two week sprint for the patient portal. Theme is results readability, measured against [Voice and Tone](voice-and-tone.md).

title: GDPR and patient data refresher
description: Mandatory yearly session with the DPO on [Patient Data Protection Policy](patient-data-protection-policy.md): retention, subject requests, the 72-hour breach clock. Register reviewed live from [data-processing-register.csv](file:Compliance/data-processing-register.csv).

title: Cardiology clinic, Plovdiv
description: Sofia cardiologist consulting in Plovdiv. Booked slots only, no walk-ins. Logistics in the [Plovdiv Clinic Guide](plovdiv-clinic-guide.md).

title: Clinic managers sync
description: Sofia and Plovdiv managers in [Iskar](room:Iskar): rota, waiting times, equipment, complaints, courier timings from the [Plovdiv Clinic Guide](plovdiv-clinic-guide.md).

title: Patient safety committee
description: Incident review and protocol changes per [Adverse Event Reporting](adverse-event-reporting-sop.md). Medical director chairs, in [Vitosha](room:Vitosha).

title: Patient education evening
description: Open session for patients on managing type 2 diabetes. [Trakia Training Room](room:Trakia Training Room) is blocked from 17:00.

title: Board meeting
description: Quarterly numbers, clinic expansion, lab accreditation status against [Lab Sample Handling SOP](lab-sample-handling-sop.md).

title: Quarterly all-hands
description: Where we are against the plan, what changed in the clinics, questions taken live and remote. Grounded in [Mission and Values](mission-and-values.md).

title: Lab QA review
description: Rejections, turnaround times, QC breaches and external quality assessment, against [lab-panel-reference-ranges.csv](file:Clinical/lab-panel-reference-ranges.csv) and the [Lab Sample Handling SOP](lab-sample-handling-sop.md).

title: First aid and resuscitation training
description: Hands-on session with the training mannequins in [Serdica](room:Serdica). Mandatory every two years for clinical staff, CPD days per [Leave and Time Off](leave-and-time-off-policy.md).

title: Flu vaccination day
description: Free vaccination for all staff in the ground floor lobby. Drop in, no booking. Parking and access notes in the [Sofia HQ Guide](sofia-hq-guide.md).
